subject: Collateral release authorization for deal concession
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Collateral release authorization for deal concession

Team — looping you in for an approval decision tied to DEAL-4821 (NovaProd). Short context: NovaProd is ready to sign but has asked for a marketing/case-study concession in exchange for a one-time revenue credit to help get legal & procurement comfortable.

Proposal on the table (customer request):
- 20% one-time revenue credit off first-year committed spend (approx $48k)
- Customer will provide: 2-page case study, 30s product demo clip, and allow logo + short quote to be used in marketing for 12 months

We typically approve up to 10% for this segment. This request exceeds the standard threshold and needs executive sign-off because it’s tied to public usage rights (legal review required). I attached the draft case study and a MAP with the credit line item.

Asks:
1) Marissa / Vivek — do we approve 20% given strategic value (vertical reference in manufacturing) and likely expansion?
2) Olga — can legal sign off on a 12-month usage release with limited claims language (no comparative claims, Redwood review of final copy)?

If we get a quick green, I’ll send the DocuSign with the release language and lock pricing.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: NovaProd_case_study_draft.pdf; MAP_NovaProd_v1.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Collateral release authorization for deal concession

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary. A few quick thoughts:
- Strategic fit: NovaProd is a high-value vertical reference; having them on the roster is a net positive for 2027 GTM.
- Price impact: 20% one-time credit (~$48k) is above the commercial playbook for self-serve/SMB deals, but within reason if we treat it as a reference investment and expect a 12–18 month payback via pipeline.

Would like to cap it to the first invoice only with no recurring discount beyond year one. Also need a published metric: customer will agree to a short metrics paragraph (e.g., "reduced inference latency by X%" — but must be reviewable).

If legal confirms the release language is narrow and time-limited, I’m inclined to approve, but we should get Vivek's sign-off on the concession bucket.

Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Collateral release authorization for deal concession

Karthik / team — reviewed the draft case study and proposed release. Redlines and requirements below: 

1) Term: 12 months from execution — acceptable.
2) Scope: Logo, quote (max 2 sentences), 30s product clip — acceptable. No use of customer data beyond aggregated metrics.
3) Claims: any performance or metric statements must be expressly approved by both parties in writing prior to publication. We cannot accept any comparative claims or sensitive benchmarks.
4) IP/Ownership: customer owns their testimonial clip and case study; Redwood has a limited license to reproduce for marketing channels listed (web, PDF, trade shows).
5) Indemnity: standard carve-outs only; no open-ended indemnity.

I will prepare a short release template and the DocuSign envelope (link below) with the redlined language. Once the customer signs, marketing can publish.

DocuSign draft: https://docusign.com/xyz/DocuSignTemplateID-77

Legal is comfortable with 20% one-time credit provided we get the signed release and a clause restricting public claims.

Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie@novaprod.com>, Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@novaprod.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Collateral release authorization for deal concession

Sophie / Tom — appreciate the quick turnaround on the draft case study. Per our internal review, legal is asking us to lock a few items before we finalize pricing:

- We need explicit sign-off on any metric statements in the case study (Redwood + NovaProd) prior to publication.
- Release will be time-limited to 12 months.
- We’ll include a short mutually agreed quote (max 2 sentences).

If you’re good with those items, I can route the DocuSign for the release. Once executed, Redwood will apply the 20% one-time credit on the first invoice.

Customer reply (inline from Sophie on 5/6):
> On Thu, May 6, 2027 at 10:58 AM, Sophie Martin <sophie@novaprod.com> wrote:
> Thanks Karthik — the draft looks fine. We can keep metrics high-level and will not include product claims. 12 months is OK. Please send the official release for signature.

Next: signing + Vivek sign-off for discount booking.

Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Collateral release authorization for deal concession

Karthik / Marissa — approved. Conditions:
1) Execute DocuSign release with legal redlines as provided.
2) Apply 20% one-time credit to first invoice only (no recurring discount).
3) Marketing must review final assets and confirm no unapproved claims prior to publish.
4) Finance to flag DEAL-4821 during booking to ensure correct recognition and crediting.

Aditya — please coordinate with finance and ops to make sure the MAP and credit are encoded in the quote and booking.

Once signed, treat as final. Great work getting this across the line.

Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
